title: AE Install Ride-Along Observation Workbook
description: Field observation workbook for Associate Account Executives completing the AE Install Ride-Along assignment: an installation team meeting, an Install Manager job shadow, and an installation technician ride-along interview/observation.
author: Johnson Controls ASCEND Learning

questions.prompt: What were the safety topics discussed, if any?
Identify 3 topics of discussion from the meeting.
questions.helpText: List three separate topics covered in the meeting.

questions.prompt: How do the topics of these meetings impact you in your role?
Notes
questions.helpText: Capture any additional observations from the installation team meeting.

questions.prompt: Describe a typical day for an Install Manager.
What weekly and monthly meetings are you responsible to attend and what office activities are you responsible to complete?
For each meeting or activity, note when and where it takes place.
questions.helpText: Include the meeting/activity name along with the timing and location.

questions.prompt: Identify (by name) the lead person for each function in this department.
Identify other personnel that you may be in contact with.
questions.helpText: For example, Admin or Safety Coordinator.

questions.prompt: Key point of contact with the Install Coordinator
questions.helpText: Describe the key points of contact between the Install Manager and this role.

questions.prompt: Key point of contact with the Lead Installation Technician
questions.helpText: Describe the key points of contact between the Install Manager and this role.

questions.prompt: Key point of contact with the Estimator / NAFSS
questions.helpText: Describe the key points of contact between the Install Manager and this role.

questions.prompt: List the different types of Johnson Controls customer accounts.
As the AAE, which of the customer accounts will you be involved with?
Which customer accounts is the Associate Account Executive (AAE) involved with, and which is the AAE NOT involved with?
questions.helpText: Distinguish the accounts the AAE is involved with from those the AAE is not.

questions.prompt: What is the Install Playbook? How does the Install Manager use it?
Describe how the Install Manager uses the following software systems: Compass, MAStermind, Installation Backlog Tool (IBT), ADMIN, Excel, Scheduling, and any other systems.
questions.helpText: Address each system: Compass, MAStermind, IBT, ADMIN, Excel, Scheduling, Other.

questions.prompt: What are the corporate procedures for using the IBT?
As the AAE, identify two tasks you will perform using the IBT.
Describe the SOW process.
Identify the key points that are included in every SOW.
What can you do as an AAE to facilitate the Install Manager role?
questions.helpText: If this is not addressed during your assignment, be sure to ask how you can facilitate this role.

questions.prompt: Describe a Final Job Review.
When preparing for approval/sign-off of the Final Job Review, what are the key elements the Install Manager looks for?
Name of Customer
Type of Business
Did you arrive at the appointment on time?
How did the Install Tech begin the conversation with the customer?
What techniques did this tech use that you will use to establish contact and credibility with the commercial customer?
What techniques did you observe on the part of the Install Tech that indicated attention to and concern for the customer’s property and peace of mind?
Based on your experience today, what do you see as the greatest challenge in managing the Installation call?
What did you learn during this appointment that will be useful to you when you are on a sales call?
Date of the ride-along appointment
questions.helpText: Record the date of the installation technician ride-along.
